<description>
**Problem:** Snapshot loading doesn't validate the announced coin count against the unique UTXOs loaded.
Repeated outpoints collapse into one coin, so a snapshot can repeat every record, announce the doubled count, and still match the committed UTXO hash.
`loadtxoutset` then reports the inflated count as `coins_loaded`.

Snapshot loading also accepts transaction groups with no coins.
They leave the UTXO hash unchanged and don't advance the coin count, so parsing them bypasses the interrupt check and can delay shutdown.

**Fix:** Compare the announced count with the unique coin count already produced by the existing UTXO statistics scan, and reject zero-count transaction groups while parsing the snapshot.
When both the content hash and coin count are wrong, loading reports the hash error first.
</description>

<commits>
8e2b70b77b test: characterize duplicate snapshot records

A repeated snapshot payload preserves the unique UTXO set and content hash while doubling the announced record count.
Record that current loading accepts this mismatch before enforcing the metadata contract.
Also preserve the content-hash error when the announced count differs from the unique UTXO count.

f1a903e47b validation: check imported unique UTXO count

Repeated records can produce the committed set while overstating the announced coin count.
Check the unique count from the existing statistics scan after the content hash, preserving hash-error precedence.

773024812c test: characterize empty snapshot groups

An empty transaction group adds no coin and leaves the committed UTXO hash unchanged.
Record its current acceptance before requiring every group to contain a coin.

e8e8cbcaa2 validation: reject empty snapshot groups

Reject transaction groups with no coins instead of accepting bytes that contribute nothing to the checked UTXO set.
Snapshots generated by dumptxoutset already contain only nonempty groups.
</commits>
